newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte says publication backs Rexene meeting.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte says publication backs Rexene meeting.

text.p: Guy Wyser-Pratte and Fred Kambeitz, the managing director of Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said Friday that a publication and advisory firm, The Proxy Monitor, had recommended that its clients support their call for a special meeting of shareholders of Rexene Corp.
Wyser-Pratte, of Wyser-Pratt & Co Inc, and Kambeitz said the Proxy Monitor's analysis rejected the Rexene board's contention that a special shareholder meeting is not necessary.
Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg own about 10.1 percent of Rexene's outstanding common stock.
